name: strike
title: Strike
summary: A giant word lands behind your head on the word you say, a red marker line strikes it out on a second cue, then the replacement word drops in and knocks it away.
keyMoment: the red line rips through the word on the strike cue; the replacement lands on its own word with a thud

variables.label: The word that appears first (shown in capitals, lands when you say it)
The spoken word that strikes it out
The spoken word that drops the replacement in
Largest type size in px (shrinks to fit the width)
How much of the word shows above your head, 0.5 to 1 (keep the strike line clear of your head)
How much the type follows your head, 0 to 1
